journey.name: wear send insufficient
journey.description:
An invoice for more than the balance is refused before the hold: the review never shows, only a cross with "Not enough funds" and one button, which returns to Home. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet on the local ./spark stack with less than 10 000 000 sats, see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack, with the app open on the Balance page and the loading ring stopped.

actions.action: Run `../bitkit-docker/spark invoice 10000000` and note the BOLT11 invoice it prints as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 10 s until "WatchSendError" is listed
Verify the Balance page: "WatchHomeBalance" is listed
